# 08: UI (desktop app)
Status: **Oct 25 build (agent U): shell/worklist/study/inspector/agent log/report+Approve/net monitor against the mock and agent W's worker (fake imaging) — verification log in `08-ui-status.md`; MVP (Oct 24) was P0 + P1 + P2 against the mock with the Acceptance tests below passing.** Kit: P0a verified on spark-2 + laptop (`nodehouse/`); P0b WebGL on GB10 passes headless and on screen. Still **unverified**: real imaging assets/coordinates (B9), fps on the box, Electron on aarch64 sandbox, voice (09).
Rebuild budget on the day: **~1.5–2 h** with a lead + 3 parallel agents against a mock, then ~30 min to switch to the real worker. MVP actuals: contract + scaffold + data layer 25 min (lead, serial); shell / study / mock agents 10–26 min in parallel; 3D / slices+ask / extras+polish agents 10–13 min in parallel; E2E + fixes 15 min.

## Purpose and scope

The radiologist's desktop app: worklist, study view (3D lung + key slices + findings + priors), live agent log, report/letter editor with the human-only **Approve**, mock EHR inbox, extras, and the "0 bytes sent" monitor on the **System page** (not the title bar). It is a client of the worker API (`00-architecture.md`); it holds no medical logic and shows only numbers that come from the findings payload.

**In:** everything the storyboard shows on screen (`docs/spark-md-storyboard.md`). **Out:** auth, multi-user, settings beyond theme, chat history. **Cut first:** U11 → U10 → U9 → U7 (see Pieces).

### Decisions (Oct 24, Ty)

| Topic | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Stack | **React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + shadcn (Radix)**, `motion` for animation, `@react-three/fiber` + `drei` over **three.js** for 3D, TanStack Query for data. Everything pre-downloaded (npm cache on the drive, P0a). |
| Desktop shell | **Electron** (bundled Chromium = predictable WebGL; official linux-arm64). Electrobun rejected: it uses WebKitGTK on Linux, WebGL on aarch64/GB10 unknown. Electron opens the worker-served UI (`http://127.0.0.1:8100/`), so there is no CORS and "approve only from loopback" holds. Plain Chromium on the same URL is the fallback. Run `electron .` directly; no packaging (AppImage tooling downloads at build time). |
| Design reference | **Linear-inspired shell, approved by Ty Oct 24**: quiet gray sidebar, retained study tabs, one continuous main surface, subdued properties rail. Mobbin references: [issue detail](https://mobbin.com/screens/cef36326-d8ec-4c6f-acd4-a9f1e1060d33), [issue list](https://mobbin.com/screens/be6c4ee4-aa93-42b4-89b3-dcfc8386f022). Original fabric reference remains useful for desktop behavior. **Dropped:** aurora background, agent avatars/sprites, assistant-ui chat, Storybook, font picker. Rebuild on the day from this spec, not copied source (build rule). |
| Theme | **Light first**, dark toggle (`.dark` class on `<html>`). Imaging stays dark in both themes. Solid gray sidebar/title bar and one main application surface; clinical section backgrounds must be transparent in both themes. Keep `backdrop-blur` for overlays, not the title bar. |
| Fonts | **Geist Variable** (UI), **Geist Mono Variable** (measurements, IDs, agent log), **Inter Variable** as the alternate sans. Self-hosted via Fontsource. |
| Screen | **1920×1080**, no scrolling during demo beats. |

### Layout (viewer-first revision, Oct 24)

Ty chose **viewer-first clinical workspace** after reviewing the first MVP. The study screen now uses two areas rather than the original findings / viewer / raw-log dashboard:

- **Patient header (single 60 px row):** `Patient <id>` + `Chest CT · T1 · Day 380` + priority inline on one baseline; review state, “Review & approve” and the **inspector toggle** (PanelRight icon, `aria-pressed`) on the right (button at the default shadcn size, no override — shrunk from `h-10` Oct 24). Collapsing animates the third grid track to 0 px over 220 ms (`transition: grid-template-columns`; the panel keeps a fixed `--inspector-w` inner width so content clips instead of reflowing, and gets `inert` when hidden); preference persists in `localStorage` (`sparkmd-inspector`). No breadcrumb; the button still opens the human-gated sheet only.
- **Imaging workspace (flexible width):** dark viewer with a dedicated toolbar (`3D anatomy`, `CT slices`, `Compare`), local focus/reset controls and mesh provenance. Mock assets carry “Synthetic preview · placeholder numbers” in the toolbar.
- **Longitudinal strip below the viewer:** flat strip separated by a top rule; header reads `Longitudinal comparison · N total scans` (priors + current) with the **Compare button at the header's right**; worker-supplied diameter change, interval and VDT in the row below. Timeline spacing is ordinal, not proportional to elapsed time. Baselines explicitly show no growth comparison. The strip wraps on the imaging column's **container** width (≤880 px), not the viewport, so it never clips when the inspector is open; the timeline row scrolls horizontally only as a last resort.
- **Agent chat rail (left of imaging, resizable, headerless):** no header — conversation starts at the top of the rail. Real history per study — question bubble, streamed markdown answer, tool chips; auto-scrolls to the newest turn; Esc stops a stream; history is session-memory. Same local ask SSE endpoint, no new API. **Drag the rail's right edge** to resize (240–560 px, pointer events on a 6 px hover-grip handle; a `.resizing` class kills the 220 ms grid transition during the drag); width persists in `localStorage.sparkmd-chat-w`, double-click the handle resets to the CSS default (300 px / 264 px ≤1550). **Borders:** rail edge and composer footer stay borderless; the **composer card has a 1 px border + shadow**. **Composer (fabric-port, Oct 24):** quick-phrase **outline** chips (rounded-full, gated while a turn streams) sit **above the card at the bottom of the chat**; the card = 2-row auto-growing textarea (56→132 px cap; Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline) over a right-aligned toolbar — disabled mic slot (09) + **circular accent Send (ArrowUp)**. While a turn streams, Send swaps to a **pulsing Stop** button and new input is gated (replaces the old abort-previous-stream behavior; Stop/Esc are the only interrupts). Not ported from fabric: context meter (no worker token-usage source), attachments, model/approval pickers.
- **Clinical inspector (380 px):** a **two-option toggle group** at the top switches `Assessment` ↔ `Agent activity` (Live pill joins the tab row in activity view). Assessment: management first, then selectable nodules with prominent mean diameter, then screenings — flat sections, transparent backgrounds, neutral 6 px selection, no enclosing card or inspector header. Activity: `StudyActivity fill` owns the panel (no internal header, trace toggle at the bottom). One vertical divider. Rule provenance expands on demand.
- **Agent activity data:** latest actual `agent_note`, recent tool/system events with expandable raw details, and a full-trace toggle. Connection indicator comes from SSE status.
- Study grid `agent chat var(--chat-w) | imaging 1fr | inspector var(--inspector-w)` (defaults 300/380 px, 264/352 px at ≤1550 px; `--chat-w` overridden inline after a drag); collapsed animates the third track to 0 px. The imaging section is a `container-type: inline-size` container; its strip and viewer toolbar wrap below 880 px column width regardless of viewport. At 1440×900 with everything open imaging wraps the strip without clipping; collapse the inspector or narrow the chat for wide anatomy. No page overflow at any drag width.

Shell remains light-first with a dark toggle; viewer/slices stay dark in both themes. Title bar is 32 px, sidebar 240 px expanded, disclaimer footer 28 px. Sidebar nav: Worklist · Studies · EHR inbox · Agent activity (System moved to the footer Oct 24). Report sheet stays ≈480 px and keeps the disclaimer visible.

### Title bar and main surface (Linear-inspired section 1, approved Oct 24)

- Left cluster: **application menu (hamburger), sidebar toggle, local study search, history Back / Forward**, in that order. Distinct controls; history behavior is unchanged.
- Study tabs stay in the title bar. **No pinned Worklist/main tab**. The `+` immediately after the scrollable tab strip opens a worklist in a new tab, labelled “New study”. Choosing a row or search result fills that slot with the study.
- Right cluster: theme toggle and Electron min/max/close only. No title-bar network pill; System retains the network monitor.
- Tabs have close buttons and middle-click close; arrow keys move focus, Enter/Space selects. Overflow scrolls internally while `+` stays reachable.
- App menu: Worklist, New study tab, Search studies, EHR inbox, Agent activity, System, theme toggle. No approval action.
- Search reads only the cached/local `/api/worklist`; patient ID, study UID, timepoint, category and review-state label are searchable. Arrow keys select, Enter opens, Escape dismisses; loading, unavailable and no-match states are explicit. No remote search.
- URL slot identity: `/?tab=<uuid>` → `/study/<uid>?tab=<same uuid>`. History Back returns that slot to its worklist; Forward restores the study. Direct study routes get a deterministic study tab. Closing the active tab selects right neighbor, then left, then untabbed Worklist. Sidebar/non-study navigation does not manufacture a persistent main tab. Tabs are session-memory state; reload reconstructs the current URL tab only.
- Main surface: **12 px outer radius with a 1 px border**, 8 px right inset against gray sidebar, **no bottom margin** (surface meets the footer), **8 px dark viewer radius**. Sidebar light tone `oklch(0.965 0 0)`. No sidebar edge border or footer top border. AppSidebar needs `border-0!`: plain `border-r-0` loses to shadcn's `group-data-[side=left]:border-r`. Inspector keeps its vertical separator; timeline/clinical sections stay flat. Preserve report sheets, menus and input boundaries. No API or approval-policy change.
- Footer: research disclaimer on the left; **“Local only · Air-gapped”** on the right, moved from the sidebar, with the **System link after it** (Server icon, muted → foreground when active, `aria-current="page"`; moved from the sidebar Oct 24). Remove the old “Spark MD · all processing on this device” footer copy and the sidebar footer entirely.
- Container/footer refinement verified Oct 24 on the laptop: build passed; browser at expanded/light 1920×1080 and collapsed/dark 1440×900 showed 1 px main border, 0 px bottom margin/gap above footer, 0 px sidebar/footer borders, relocated status visible, no page overflow. The removed 8 px gap was an outer margin (`mb-2`), not inner imaging padding.

## Interfaces

Consumes the worker API in `00-architecture.md` §Worker API. The UI never calls the agent tools' write routes except **approve** and `/api/ask`.

| UI need | Route |
| --- | --- |
| Worklist | `GET /api/worklist` |
| Study header, series, priors | `GET /api/studies/{uid}` |
| Findings, assessment, extras, asset URLs | `GET /api/studies/{uid}/findings` |
| Meshes, key slices | `GET /api/studies/{uid}/assets/{name}` |
| Reports | `GET /api/studies/{uid}/reports`; `POST /api/reports/{id}/approve {approver}` |
| Ask | `POST /api/ask {study_uid, text}` (streamed) |
| Inbox, net | `GET /api/outbox`, `GET /api/netstats` |
| Live updates | `GET /api/events` (SSE) |

Added for the UI (pinned in the MVP, Oct 24): `GET /api/agent-log?study_uid=&limit=` → `AgentEvent[]` oldest first (log history; SSE appends after).

**SSE wire format (pinned):** `id: <seq>\nevent: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n`; keep-alive comment `: ping` every 15 s; the browser resends `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect and the worker replays `agent_log` after it (best effort). Payloads are small notifications: the UI refetches the resource except where it writes the payload straight into the query cache.

| Event | Payload (pinned) | UI reaction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_log` | `AgentEvent {id, ts, study_uid\|null, source: tool_call\|agent_note\|system, message, tool?, status?, duration_ms?}` | append to the global + per-study log caches (dedupe by `id`, cap 2000) |
| `worklist_changed` | `{reason: received\|status\|priority\|reset, study_uid\|null}` | refetch worklist → animated reorder; `reset` invalidates everything |
| `study_updated` | `{study_uid, status}` | refetch study + findings |
| `job_progress` | `{job_id, study_uid, state: queued\|running\|done\|failed, stage, stage_index, elapsed_s}` | written into the study cache → stage stepper |
| `viewer_command` | `{command: show_nodule\|compare_prior\|reset_view\|show_extras, study_uid, nodule_id?}` | not cached: fanned out on an in-memory bus to the viewer / compare / extras |
| `report_saved` | `{study_uid, report_id, kind, version, status}` | refetch reports + worklist (awaiting badge) |
| `outbox_delivered` | `{outbox_id, report_id, study_uid, patient_id, recipient, subject}` | refetch outbox + toast |
| `net_stats` | `{tx_bytes, rx_bytes, since, interfaces[], link_up}` every 2 s | written into the netstats cache → System network monitor |

Job stages (pinned for the UI; the real list comes from 04/L3, **unverified**): `organize, select, volume, detect, segment, characterize, match, rules, render`.

Worklist row = `{study_uid, patient_id, timepoint, day_offset, status, priority, priority_reason, lung_rads|null, received_at, reports_awaiting}`; `GET /api/studies/{uid}` = row + `series[]`, `priors[] {study_uid, timepoint, day_offset, status, lung_rads}`, `job|null`. Findings as in 00 plus `placeholder?: bool` (fixtures → UI shows a "placeholder numbers" tag) and `assets.key_slices[] = {name, url, plane, nodule_id, box_px[x,y,w,h]|null}`; `nodule_mesh` = one glb, one node per `nodule_id`.

**Demo state (pinned, demo harness only):** `GET /api/demo/state` and SSE `demo_state` = `{replaying, patient_id|null, timepoint|null, speed}` (sent on replay start, each timepoint drop, replay end, reset). The UI shows the replay banner and a `<speed>×` badge when `speed ≠ 1` (honesty rule). `extras.vertebra.flag?: string|null` = the worker's rule text (e.g. "possible osteoporosis"); the UI shows it verbatim and never derives it.

**`/api/ask` stream (pinned):** `POST {study_uid, text}` → `text/event-stream` in our own frames, so the UI doesn't care which harness answers (the worker adapts OpenClaw/Hermes chat streams): `event: delta {text}` (markdown chunk) · `event: tool {tool, args}` (informational; the actual viewer move arrives via SSE `viewer_command`) · `event: done {ok}` · `event: error {message}`. `EventSource` can't POST, so the UI reads it with `fetch` + a `\n\n` frame parser.

**Voice addition (Ty confirmed Oct 24; unverified in UI):** implement 09 push-to-talk + spoken answers, label "Synthetic voice (Qwen3-TTS, on device)", provide mute, and stop playback before microphone capture. Call `/api/tts` after the ask finishes; the worker coordinates shared GPU load. Canonical viewer phrases cause immediate worker SSE actions before agent response; the UI must not also move the camera locally.

**Approve (pinned):** `POST /api/reports/{id}/approve {approver}` → 200 `{report, outbox_id, already_approved:false}`; already approved → **409** with the same body shape (`already_approved:true`, the original approver/time), which the UI treats as success-state; nodules still unconfirmed → **409** `{error:"confirm_all_first", already_approved:false}` with no `report`, which the UI shows as an error. **Treat 409 as success only when `already_approved === true`** (00 v0.8). Not from `127.0.0.1` → 403 `{error:"approve_loopback_only"}`. UX: the header's Approve opens the report sheet (the human reads the text first); one Approve button per report; approver name defaults to "Dr. Joyce (demo)" (editable); no keyboard shortcut, no auto-approve; after approval the button becomes "Approved by X at HH:MM" and the `outbox_delivered` toast fires.

Env: `SPARKMD_UI_URL` (Electron start URL; default `http://127.0.0.1:8100/`).

**Confirm diameters (Oct 25, proposed with 00 v0.6; not implemented in the MVP):**
- A study with `status = awaiting_confirmation` shows a **Needs confirmation** pill (`warn`), no Lung-RADS badge and no assessment block. The inspector's Assessment view lists each nodule as a row: lobe, **proposed** diameter (A7, labeled "Proposed"), detector-box diameter as a muted cross-check, editable **long** and **short** diameter fields (1 decimal, mm) prefilled from the proposal, and the worker-computed mean shown read-only after confirm (00 v0.8; the UI never computes the mean). Selecting a row flies the 3D camera and CT slices to it; the A7 mask shows as an overlay (when `assets` provides one).
- Buttons: **Confirm** per nodule and **Confirm all** (disabled until every field is a valid number > 0). The UI sends `POST /api/nodules/{id}/confirm {long_mm, short_mm, by}` (short ≤ long); it never computes the mean, volume, growth, VDT or category. After confirm, refetch on `study_updated` and `worklist_changed`. Growth shows `prior.growth_per_12mo_mm`, with "normalized to 12 mo" when `prior.growth_normalized` is true. A confirmed row shows an "Edited" tag when the value differs from the proposal and can be re-confirmed (the worker recomputes).
- Errors: 403 (not loopback) and 409 are shown inline; fail-closed proposals (null) show an empty field with "No proposal — enter a diameter".
- After the last confirm the worker emits `study_updated` + `worklist_changed`; the UI refetches findings and the assessment appears, then the agent's report drafts arrive (`report_saved`) after the phase-2 run (07). Show the agent log line "Confirmed by <name>; drafting reports" between them so the wait is explained.
- Worklist: `awaiting_confirmation` rows show the pill and an empty Lung-RADS cell. Status text for the demo: "Needs confirmation" (warn), not "Awaiting approval", which stays for `reported`.
- **Demo impact (Joyce):** the radiologist confirms one diameter per timepoint before the category appears. The storyboard's "agent flags growth at year 2" now appears after the T1 confirm click, so the log must show the wait. Update `docs/spark-md-storyboard.md` after Ty confirms 00 v0.6.
- Acceptance (not run): confirm hero T0 → T1 arrives → pill shows "Needs confirmation" → confirm → category appears → report drafts → Approve; typed diameter with an unreasonable value (0, negative, > 100) is rejected client-side and by the worker.

## Build steps

Measured on the laptop MVP (Oct 24, 16:30–17:10); repeat on the day in the event repo's `ui/`. P1/P2 steps are at the end of the list once verified.

1. **Install offline** (local disk, not CIFS): `export npm_config_cache=$NH/npm-cache npm_config_offline=true ELECTRON_CACHE=$NH/electron-cache`; copy `$NH/ui/{package.json,package-lock.json,components.json}`; `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node node_modules/electron/install.js`. Verify: `ls node_modules/electron/dist/electron` exists; laptop 4 s.
2. **Scaffold by hand** (no `create-vite`, no `shadcn init`): `index.html`, `vite.config.ts` (react-swc + `@tailwindcss/vite`, alias `@` → `src`, dev proxy `/api` → `127.0.0.1:8100`), `tsconfig.json` (`paths @/*`, `types: ["vite/client"]`), `src/lib/utils.ts` (`cn`). Add scripts `dev`, `build: tsc -b && vite build`, and `"main": "electron/main.cjs"`.
3. **shadcn components in one go** from the snapshot: `OFFLINE=1 python3 -I $NH/serve_registry.py $NH/shadcn 4000 & echo $! > /tmp/reg.pid`; `REGISTRY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000/r npx --offline shadcn add -y -o <all 22>`; `kill $(cat /tmp/reg.pid)`. Verify: 22 files in `src/components/ui/`, `package.json` deps unchanged vs the kit.
4. **Tokens + fonts** in `src/index.css`: `@import` tailwind, `tw-animate-css`, `shadcn/tailwind.css`, the three Fontsource packages; `@custom-variant dark`; `@theme inline` mapping; `:root` / `.dark` values (Parameters). shadcn writes none of this (Gotchas).
5. **Electron main** (`electron/main.cjs` + `preload.cjs`): frameless 1920×1080, `spellcheck:false`, `contextIsolation`, loads `SPARKMD_UI_URL`; IPC for min/max/close exposed as `window.sparkmd`; `use-angle=gl-egl` on arm64; a `webRequest.onBeforeRequest` filter that **cancels anything not loopback / `10.77.0.1`** (belt-and-braces for the air gap). Verify: `SPARKMD_UI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8100/ npx electron .` opens frameless.
6. **Contract first** (`src/api/types.ts`, from §Interfaces), then the **data layer**: `client.ts` (fetch wrapper; approve resolves 409; `ask()` async generator over the SSE-framed POST), `keys.ts`, `hooks.ts` (one `useQuery` per route; findings `retry:false`), `sse.ts` (one `EventSource`, a handler per event → `invalidateQueries` / `setQueryData`; invalidate everything on reopen), `viewer-bus.ts`. QueryClient: `staleTime 5 s`, no refetch on focus, **no retry on 4xx**. Hash router (worker serves `dist/` statically). Verify: `npx tsc -b`.
7. **Shell** (U1): title bar → gray sidebar → rounded main surface → footer (Snippets: drag regions, alignment, URL-backed tab slots). Add local search using existing Dialog primitives and worklist hook, and hamburger menu using DropdownMenu. **Worklist** (U3), **EHR inbox**, **System**. Verify: `+` → worklist → row opens in the same tab; search with keyboard; back/forward; close last tab → worklist; overflowing strip keeps `+` accessible; replay still reorders T1.
8. **Study view** (U5) + **agent log** (U4) + **report sheet / Approve** (U8). Verify: replay → stepper runs → findings → Review & approve → Approve → toast → inbox.
9. **Build + run like the event:** `npx vite build` → the worker serves `dist/` at `/` → `SPARKMD_UI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8100/ npx electron .`. Verify with the E2E script (Acceptance tests). `vite build` 0.7 s; main chunk 869 kB (272 kB gzip) before code-splitting three.js.
10. **3D viewer** (U6, `React.lazy` chunk): fiber `useLoader(GLTFLoader)` — **not** drei `useGLTF` (Gotchas) — clone the scene, own materials (fresnel lung, emissive nodules), drei `CameraControls makeDefault`, auto-rotate in `useFrame`, `viewer_command` via the bus → fly-to / home (Snippets). Mode switch 3D | Slices | Compare over the well; the 3D scene stays mounted (paused) under the 2D modes. Verify: `curl -XPOST :8100/api/viewer/command -d '{"command":"show_nodule","study_uid":…}'` → camera settles in ~1.2 s, label shows lobe + mean mm. `vite build` → separate `lung-3d` chunk (1.0 MB / 273 kB gz).
11. **Key slices + compare** (U7): PNG + SVG overlay in PNG pixel space (no scaling code); compare = prior | Δ/interval/VDT | current, all from `nodule.prior`. Initialise `SlicesView` selection from the viewer’s last nodule request; selecting #2 in 3D then opening CT must not silently show #1. **Ask box** (U9): `ask()` generator, abort on new question / Esc, input and fixed phrases on separate rows, disabled mic slot. Verify: all four chips stream answers quoting findings numbers; `compare_prior` switches the well to Compare.
12. **Extras card** (U10, slides in row by row on `show_extras`), **System** page net sparkline; **replay banner + operator shortcuts** (U11: Ctrl+Shift+R reset, +P replay, +D dark; never approve). Verify: replay → banner with phase word; `show_extras` → 4 rows staggered 350 ms.
13. On the GB10: `chrome-sandbox` fix (Gotchas) before running Electron; `use-angle=gl-egl` is the arm64 default in `main.cjs`.

The MVP was built by one lead + three parallel agents in ~35 min for steps 1–9 (lead: steps 1–6 in ~25 min; shell, study and mock agents ~10–25 min each against the frozen contract). On the day: do 1–6 first and freeze `types.ts` before parallelising.

| `--run` / `--run-soft` | `#1d4ed8` / `#dbeafe` | `#93b4ff` / `#1e2d5a` | analyzing |
| `--ok` / `--ok-soft` | `#15803d` / `#dcfce7` | `#6ee7a0` / `#12351f` | approved, stable |
| `--warn` / `--warn-soft` | `#b45309` / `#fef3c7` | `#fbbf6a` / `#3a2a0c` | elevated priority, awaiting approval |
| `--replay` / `--replay-soft` | `#6d28d9` / `#ede9fe` | `#c4b5fd` / `#2e2150` | time-machine replay |

New token `--alert` / `--alert-soft`: light `#b91c1c` / `#fee2e2`, dark `#fca5a5` / `#45161a` (4B/4X, urgent). `--well` `#0b0d10` (dark `#07080a`) for the 3D/slice well in both themes.

**3D viewer** (tuned on mock meshes; retune on real anatomy): FOV 35°, near 1 / far 5000 (mm). Home = anterior, distance `r / sin(fov/2) × 0.82` (r = lung bounding-sphere radius). Focus distance `clamp(r × 1.6, 160, 400)` mm (retuned on the real hero mesh Oct 24; r × 1.1 framed only ~12 cm), view direction = the nodule's own side (centre → nodule in xz) + 0.35 anterior bias, elevation 0.3, so the camera stays outside the lung. `smoothTime 0.28` → settles in ~1.2 s. Auto-rotate 0.18 rad/s about S (~35 s/turn), resumes 6 s after a drag; stays put after `show_nodule` until `reset_view`. Lung: fresnel `ShaderMaterial` `#9db8d8`, alpha `0.07 + 0.5·(1−|n·v|)²`, double side, no depth write. Airways (real-CT glb node `airways`): same shader `#d8e6f2`, alpha ×1.7, renderOrder 1, excluded from the framing sphere (the trachea would pull the orbit centre up). Vessels (node `vessels`): same shader `#e3a3ae`, alpha ×2.2. Skeleton (node `skeleton`): `#efe4cf`, alpha ×0.9, damped (λ 4) to ×0.25 while a nodule is focused so the ribs don't sit between camera and nodule. Both are layer toggles in the well, shown only when the glb has the node; the provenance line lists the layers present. Shader adds a soft view-space key light `0.7 + 0.45·(½ + ½·n·(0.35, 0.8, 0.5))` so the translucent lung shows its shape. Home view is raised 0.14 rad (~8°). R/L markers: drei `<Html>` 4 mm outside each lung's lateral bbox at 80 % height (they follow rotation, so they stay anatomically correct). Driver nodule emissive `#ffad5c` pulsing 1.1–2.0 (~2.6 s), others `#7cc4ff` 0.4; additive halo sphere `max(2.4 r, 4 mm)` instead of post-processing. Fade-in 0.9 s, keyed by `study_uid` (T0 → T1 re-fades). Ambient 0.55 + two directionals.

**Slices / ask / extras / banner:** bracket overlay `pad = max(3, W/128)` px outside `box_px`, 2 px non-scaling stroke, `--warn` current / grey prior; `image-rendering: pixelated`. Compare grid `1fr 168px 1fr`. Chat turns render inline in the rail (14 px answer, streaming `▍` caret, `bg-muted` question bubble); no floating answer card. Extras stagger 350 ms (agent-driven). Inspector scrolls internally when extras expand or at smaller desktop sizes. Recent activity height 208 px; full trace 360 px capped at 50% of inspector. Replay banner = 2 px `bg-replay` line + 28 px pill centred over the patient header, absolutely positioned (no layout shift). Net sparkline: 120 s ring buffer of `net_stats`, SVG by hand.
**Slice stack carousel (CT slices tab, Oct 24):** when `findings.assets.slice_stack` exists, CT slices shows the full axial stack as a coverflow carousel (`slices/slice-carousel.tsx`) instead of one key slice; without it the single key-slice view remains (900101/900102 fixtures). Contract: `slice_stack = {count, spacing_mm, z_mm[] (index 0 = most superior), size, url_pattern "…/assets/stack_{i}.jpg", index_digits, nodule_slices[{nodule_id, index, box_px, half_range}]}`; mock hero only (`mock/real_stack.py` writes `stack_NNN.jpg` — lung window W1500/L−600, q90, same orientation/grid as `key_axial_*.png`, no burned-in box — plus `stack.json`; `server.py` adds the field; hero T0/T1/T2 = 151/158/152 slices at 2 mm, ~15 MB per study). Behaviour: base card `min(86cqh, 40cqw)` square; centre scaled ×1.3 (≈430 px at 1920×1080), ±3 neighbours unchanged at ×.68/.58/.5/.44, `rotateY` ∓34°, `translateZ −60 px·|o|`, brightness −13 %/step, x offset `0.88 + 0.17·(|o|−1)` base-card widths (pushed out so the larger centre does not hide the first neighbours entirely; the centre's nodule label scales with it), 200 ms transform transition, cards keyed by slice index so paging slides; |o| = 4 faded out. Input: mouse wheel (native non-passive listener, 100 delta units = 1 slice, trackpads accumulate), ←/→/↑/↓ = 1, PageUp/PageDown = 10, click a neighbour card, range scrubber with orange nodule ticks. Starts on the picked nodule's slice (thumbnail / 3D / `show_nodule` jump there); thumbnail column kept (right-3, top-14) and the carousel reserves `pr-28` for it. Bracket + label on any slice within `half_range = max(1, round(mean_mm/2/spacing))` of the nodule slice (label on the centre card only). Text is minimal: `Slice n / count` bottom-left and `z −218.3 mm` bottom-right of the well, the scrubber centred at the bottom, and "nodule #k … on this slice" / "#k … N slices above|below" centred on the caption row (top, same line as "Axial CT stack"). No plane/spacing text, no keyboard hint. The caption row no longer shows the timepoint/day or "lung window" (removed in the single key-slice view too). ±10 slices are preloaded. Gray | Color toggle applies to every card. Caption reads "Axial CT stack" (key-slice fallback: "Axial key slice"). Known gaps: re-clicking the already-selected nodule thumbnail does not re-centre after scrolling away; slice count/spacing from the real CT, but `box_px` is the detector box on the centre slice only (not a measurement); GB10 and the real worker contract **unverified**.

**Slice colour (CT slices tab, Oct 24):** `Gray | Color` toggle (button group, label "Color" — formerly "Tissue colour") pinned top-right of the well (`right-4 top-2.5`) in both the CT slices and Compare modes (thumbnail column moved down to `top-14` to clear it); applies to main slice, thumbnails and Compare, persisted in `localStorage.sparkmd-slice-color` (default gray; radiologists read grey). Key-slice PNGs are 8-bit lung window W1500/L−600, so `HU = g/255·1500 − 1350` and a 256-entry table maps each grey to a tissue colour: jet-style bright palette (revised Oct 24 to match the Kaggle look): −1350 deep blue · −1000 blue · −850 azure · −700 cyan · −450 aqua-green · −250 lime · −100 yellow · −30 orange · 30 red-orange · 100 red · 150 dark red (linear between stops); soft tissue (heart, muscle, solid nodules ≈ 40 HU) therefore reads orange/red and cannot be told from a nodule by colour alone, so in Color mode the nodule brackets turn white for contrast. Applied in the browser as an SVG `feComponentTransfer` table filter (`filter: url(#slice-tissue-lut)`, `color-interpolation-filters=sRGB`, defs mounted once in `SlicesView`) — no canvas, because worker PNGs are cross-origin and would taint it, and no new assets. The window clips at ~+150 HU, so bone is one flat colour. Colour bands are display choices, **not a validated clinical scheme**; verified by screenshot on mock hero T1 only (dark theme, other studies, GB10 **unverified**).

Lung-RADS badge scale (pinned; colour = urgency of management, not a diagnosis): 0 muted · 1, 2 `ok-soft`/`ok` · 3 `warn-soft`/`warn` · 4A solid `warn` · 4B solid `alert` · 4X solid `alert` + ring. Priority text: routine muted, elevated `warn`, urgent `alert`. Status pills: received/organized muted, analyzing/analyzed `run`, awaiting_confirmation = "Needs confirmation" `warn` (Oct 25, proposed), reported = "Awaiting approval" `warn`, approved `ok`, failed `alert`. Title bar 32 px; sidebar 240 px expanded; study header one 60 px row; study grid `300px | 1fr | 380px` (264/352 px at ≤1550 px, third column drops when the inspector is collapsed).

## Gotchas (known before the MVP)

- **Per-platform native npm binaries** (SWC, Tailwind oxide, lightningcss, rolldown): npm caches only the current platform's. An x86-filled cache fails on the box → the kit was filled on both (P0a).
- **Electron 44 has no postinstall:** after `npm ci`, run `node node_modules/electron/install.js` with `ELECTRON_CACHE=nodehouse/electron-cache`, or `electron` has no binary.
- **Electron `chrome-sandbox` on DGX OS** (`apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1`): aborts with "SUID sandbox helper … owned by root and has mode 4755". Fix with sudo: `chown root:root` + `chmod 4755` on `node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox`. `--no-sandbox` is a fallback only.
- **shadcn adds npm deps** (`cn`, `next-themes`); they're in the manifest. Hand-write `components.json` (copy `nodehouse/ui/components.json`); `shadcn init` isn't needed.
- **Chromium spellcheck** downloads dictionaries from Google → `webPreferences.spellcheck: false`. No auto-updater.
- **shadcn components come from an online registry** → serve `nodehouse/shadcn/` with `serve_registry.py` and set `REGISTRY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000/r`.
- **drei can reach the network:** `<Environment preset>` fetches HDRs from a CDN, `<Text>` loads remote fonts. Banned; use plain lights.
- No CDNs, no web fonts, no Web Speech API (AGENTS.md non-negotiable 2).

## Gotchas (found in the MVP, Oct 24)

- **`shadcn add` with a hand-written `components.json` writes no theme variables** into `src/index.css` (it only adds component files). Write the `@theme inline` block + `:root`/`.dark` tokens yourself (Parameters table). *MVP, laptop.*
- **`pkill -f serve_registry.py` kills your own shell** when run in the same `bash -c` that started it (the pattern matches the shell's command line). Stop it by PID: `python3 -I … & echo $! > /tmp/reg.pid` … `kill $(cat /tmp/reg.pid)`.
- **`node_modules` on the CIFS mount is slow:** build in a local dir (MVP used `~/spark-md-mvp/ui`); `npm ci` from the kit took 4 s there.
- **shadcn `Sidebar` is `fixed inset-y-0 h-svh`** → sits under the title bar. Override `top-(--titlebar-h) bottom-(--footer-h) h-auto`; `SidebarProvider` needs `h-svh min-h-0` or the inset overflows 1080. `SidebarMenuBadge` hides in icon mode → own absolutely-positioned dot.
- **shadcn `Sheet` side classes (`data-[side=right]:inset-y-0 h-full`) beat plain `top-*`** (attribute-selector specificity) → `top-[…]! bottom-[…]! h-auto!` to keep the title bar and disclaimer visible.
- **Radix Sheet auto-focuses the first focusable** (could be Approve) → `onOpenAutoFocus={e => e.preventDefault()}` and focus the approver input, never the button. Approve ignores keyboard-synthesised clicks (`e.detail === 0`): mouse only (costs keyboard a11y; demo choice).
- **TanStack keeps stale `data` when a refetch fails** → after a reset, findings 404 but the old payload still renders. Gate: `fq.isError || fq.data?.study_uid !== uid ? undefined : fq.data`.
- **Default query retry hammers 404s** (the mock saw `GET /api/studies/<uid>` ~4×/s before the study existed) → global `retry: (n, e) => !(e is 4xx) && n < 2`; SSE drives the refetch.
- **Priority went stale in the study header**: `worklist_changed{reason:"priority"}` only refetched the worklist → `sse.ts` also invalidates `study(uid)` when the event carries a `study_uid`.
- **Hidden/offscreen Electron windows don't run rAF** → `motion` animations freeze in captures. Capture with `webPreferences.offscreen:true` + `setFrameRate(30)`, or drive a shown window over CDP (`Page.captureScreenshot`).
- **Agent-log auto-scroll:** smooth scrolling breaks stick-to-bottom during bursts (mid-animation scroll events look like the user scrolled up) → instant `scrollTop = scrollHeight` in `useLayoutEffect` (Snippets).
- **Worklist reorder:** `motion.tr layout="position"` works in a real `<table>` in Electron 44 (no div-grid needed); rows need a **solid background** or they show through each other mid-move. The worker's sort must be **total** (final tie-break `study_uid`) or rows twitch on every refetch.
- **Sonner bottom-right covers the sheet footer** ("Approved by …") → `position="top-center" offset={44}`; its description text is near-invisible in light theme → `toastOptions.classNames.description = "!text-muted-foreground"`.
- **Middle-click tab close:** `onAuxClick` + `preventDefault` on mousedown, or Chromium shows the autoscroll cursor. Forward-button state: track the max `history.state.idx` yourself.
- **Worker side (for 06):** `HTTPServer.server_bind` does a reverse-DNS `getfqdn()` that **hangs offline** when binding `0.0.0.0` → override it if the worker uses `http.server`/socketserver. The initial `net_stats` frame must carry no `id:` (would reuse a seq). Keep `AgentEvent.id` monotonic across demo resets (the UI dedups by id). Outbox reads sorted by `ts desc`. Study status `approved` only when **all** latest reports are approved.
- **drei `useGLTF` configures a DRACOLoader pointing at `https://www.gstatic.com/draco/…`** (fetched only for Draco-compressed glbs, but it's a CDN in the bundle). Use fiber `useLoader(GLTFLoader)` from `three/examples/jsm` (or `useGLTF(url, false, false)`); `grep -c gstatic dist/assets/*.js` → 0.
- **Auto-rotate accumulates `azimuthAngle`** → a tween to azimuth 0 spins several turns. `normalizeRotations()` + a ±2π instant rotate before `setLookAt(…, true)` (Snippets).
- drei `<Html>` labels need `pointerEvents: none` or they eat canvas drags; R3F raycasts only objects with handlers, so the translucent lung doesn't block nodule clicks.
- **Occluded / hidden windows throttle rAF** → motion animations and R3F stall; the first E2E captures showed a half-drawn compare view, empty extras rows and a mode toggle one step behind. Fix: `webPreferences.backgroundThrottling:false` in main (also protects screen recording) and, for test runs, `--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding`.
- **Electron's default app menu binds Ctrl+Shift+R (force reload) and Ctrl+R** → `Menu.setApplicationMenu(null)` (set `SPARKMD_DEVMENU=1` to keep it for DevTools). Match shortcuts on `e.code` (`"KeyR"`), not `e.key` (Shift makes it `"R"`); ignore them in inputs.
- The shadcn snapshot has **no Popover**; `import { Popover } from "radix-ui"` works (same package).
- Disabled `<button>` gets no pointer events → Radix tooltip never opens; wrap it in a `<span tabIndex={0}>` trigger (mic slot).
- Fit a square image in both dimensions: `container-type: size` outer + inner `width: min(100cqw, calc(100cqh * W/H))`; `aspect-ratio` + `h-full max-w-full` breaks when width clamps.
- The theme lives in `localStorage` (shared Electron profile): screenshot scripts that switch to dark must restore light.
- **`pgrep -f`/`pkill -f` with a literal pattern matches your own shell** → bracket one character (`pgrep -f "remote-debugging-port=93[3]"`).
- **CDP-driven tests:** a leftover Electron still holding `--remote-debugging-port` makes the next run attach to the old window (`bind() failed: Address already in use` in the log) → kill by PID before re-running.
- **Sibling keys must be unique:** keying both `FindingsCard` and `ExtrasCard` with the same study UID retained an obsolete skeleton alongside loaded findings on refetch. Key the inspector once by study UID; do not duplicate child keys.

Run on the laptop, Oct 24 ~17:05, against the mock worker serving `dist/` on `127.0.0.1:8101` (`MOCK_SPEED=0.5`), driving the **real** `electron/main.cjs` over CDP (`--remote-debugging-port`; script `tools/e2e.mjs`, ~45 s: reset → replay 134503 → worklist → T1 study → sheet → real mouse click on Approve → inbox; it collects every request URL via `Network.requestWillBeSent`).

| --- | --- |
| App loads; DevTools Network shows only `127.0.0.1` | **pass**: 36 requests, 0 non-loopback (fonts bundled, no CDN) |
| Time machine plays through the UI | **pass**: T0 arrives → reported LR 2 routine; T1 → LR 4B, elevated, row animates to the top (shots in `docs/benchmarks/2026-10-24-ui-screens/`) |

| Disclaimer visible; 1920×1080 without page scroll | **pass** (`scrollHeight == innerHeight`; disclaimer in the footer on every page) |
| Every number on the study view matches the findings payload | by construction (the UI formats only, fixed decimals); not diffed automatically — **unverified** |
| Talk to the scan (4 fixed phrases via the chips) | **pass** (17:17 run): "Show me the nodule" → `show_nodule` → camera flies to T1-N1 + label; "Compare…" → Compare view with prior 4.0 mm / current 5.6 mm, +1.6 mm, VDT 261 d; "Why…" → 2 sentences quoting LR 4B, 5.6 mm, 41 HU, +1.6 mm/380 d, VDT 261 d (all from the mock payload); "Reset" → home + auto-rotate. Mock answers are scripted, not the LLM |

| Approve the PCP letter (storyboard) | **pass**: PCP tab → Approve → inbox, 0 non-loopback requests over the whole 60 s flow (47 requests) |
| `npm ci --offline` with egress blocked on the box | P0a pass on spark-2 (see `nodehouse/README.md`) |
| Approve from non-loopback → 403 | mock: pass (curl from a 0.0.0.0 bind). Real worker + sandbox: 07 (policy 403) |

## Measured performance

- **WebGL on GB10 (P0b, Oct 24, spark-2, headless offscreen):** WebGL2 on the GPU via ANGLE. `--use-angle=vulkan` → `NVIDIA GB10 Vulkan 1.4.312`; `--use-angle=gl-egl` → `NVIDIA GB10/PCIe, OpenGL ES 3.2`. A 333k-triangle translucent mesh + nodule at 1920×1080 holds 16.7 ms frames (60 fps cap). With no flag, the headless run fails (ANGLE wants an X display). **On screen** (GNOME 46 Wayland session over RDP, GPU-backed): default, `vulkan`, `gl-egl` and `--ozone-platform=x11` all render on the GB10 at ~16.7 ms median. **Launch flag: pin `app.commandLine.appendSwitch("use-angle", "gl-egl")`** (same renderer as the desktop default, and it works headless too); fallback `--ozone-platform=x11`. Record: `docs/benchmarks/2026-10-24-ui-webgl-gb10.md`; probe: `bench/ui_webgl_probe/`.
- **Superseded Oct 25 (event box, X11 GNOME, on-screen):** `use-angle=gl-egl` never presents WebGL frames to the window (screen stuck on the first frame while the page renders; CDP screenshots look fine, only `xwd -id` of the window shows it). Default ANGLE (`OpenGL 4.5.0`) and `vulkan` present correctly; GPU-process CPU while spinning the camera: default 8.3 %, vulkan 18.5 %, gl-egl 19.8 %. `main.cjs` no longer pins a backend on Linux.
- **3D viewer on the real hero mesh (laptop RTX 3080, Oct 24 ~21:00, offscreen `fpsoff` probe):** threshold-mask lung + airway glb from B9 (~100k tris, 2.4 MB; ~295k tris / 7.0 MB with vessels + skeleton) holds the 240 fps cap (p50 4.2 ms) idle and focused; show_nodule settles in 1.1 s (240 fps) / 1.5 s (60 fps). Real key slices + compare render correctly with `box_px` from the PNG grid. GB10 is still **unverified**.
- **3D viewer (laptop RTX 3080, Oct 24, rAF-interval probe):** visible window 58.9 fps (p50 16.7 ms, vsync cap; Hyprland tiled it to 414×1111); offscreen at the real 1012×880 well 240 fps cap (p50 4.2 ms). Mock lung = 3.7k triangles, so this flatters the real mesh. **GB10 fps with the real mesh: unverified** (P0b: 333k tris held 60 fps).
- **UI MVP (laptop x64, Oct 24):** `npm ci` 4 s; `vite build` 0.7 s; final bundle main 912 kB / 284 kB gzip + lazy `lung-3d` 1,024 kB / 273 kB gzip. Approve → outbox < 50 ms; SSE recovery 1.5 s after a worker restart.
- Offline install (P0a, Oct 24): spark-2 `npm ci` 606 packages 6 s, `vite build` of an R3F + shadcn probe 0.28 s; laptop `npm ci` 2 s. Probe bundle 1.19 MB (327 kB gzip), single chunk; code-split three.js if load time matters.

## Snippets

**SSE → query cache** (`sse.ts`; one `EventSource` for the app, mounted above the router):
```ts
const handlers: { [K in SseEventType]: (qc: QueryClient, d: SseEvents[K]) => void } = {
  agent_log: (qc, d) => { appendLog(qc, undefined, d); if (d.study_uid) appendLog(qc, d.study_uid, d) }, // dedupe by id, cap 2000
  worklist_changed: (qc, d) => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.worklist })
    if (d.study_uid) qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.study(d.study_uid) })
    if (d.reason === "reset") qc.invalidateQueries() },
  study_updated: (qc, d) => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.study(d.study_uid) }); qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.findings(d.study_uid) }) },
  job_progress: (qc, d) => qc.setQueryData<Study>(qk.study(d.study_uid), (s) => (s ? { ...s, job: d } : s)),
  viewer_command: (_qc, d) => viewerBus.emit(d),          // transient action, not cached state
  report_saved: (qc, d) => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.reports(d.study_uid) }); qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.worklist }) },
  outbox_delivered: (qc, d) => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.outbox }); toast.success(`Delivered to ${d.recipient}`) },
  net_stats: (qc, d) => qc.setQueryData(qk.netstats, d),
}
// es.onopen: if it was down, qc.invalidateQueries() (refetch whatever was missed).
// es.onerror: if es.readyState === CLOSED (non-200 during a restart), close and reconnect yourself after 2 s.
```

**Drag regions** (frameless window): the whole header drags, every control opts out.
```tsx
<header className="drag fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 flex h-(--titlebar-h) items-center bg-sidebar">
  <Button className="no-drag size-7" />       {/* every interactive control opts out */}
  <TabStrip />                                {/* the tablist still drags in the gaps between tabs */}
  {window.sparkmd && <WindowControls />}      {/* min/max/close only in Electron (preload bridge) */}
</header>
/* index.css */ .drag { -webkit-app-region: drag } .no-drag { -webkit-app-region: no-drag }
```

**Agent log: stick to bottom unless the user scrolled up:**
```tsx
useLayoutEffect(() => {
  const el = ref.current!; const added = len - prevLen.current; prevLen.current = len
  if (stick.current) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight      // instant, not smooth
  else setUnseen((n) => n + added)                       // drives the "N new events ↓" pill
}, [len])
const onScroll = () => { const el = ref.current!
  stick.current = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 32; if (stick.current) setUnseen(0) }
```

**RAS → three** (as used; checked on real CT Oct 24 with the B9 prototype: hero nodule lands in the left lung, anterior view shows patient-right on screen-left, glb node vs `center_mm` < 0.01 mm; the mock glbs match it to 0.0 mm and the viewer warns if a node is > 2 mm from its `center_mm`):
```ts
/** RAS mm → three/glTF: x = patient Left (−R), y = Superior, z = Anterior. Right-handed, mm, not recentred. */
export const rasToThree = ([r, a, s]: [number, number, number]) => new THREE.Vector3(-r, s, a)
// camera on +z looking −z = anterior view, patient-right on viewer-left (radiological). Nodule node name = nodule_id.
```

**Camera move (`show_nodule`)** with drei `CameraControls`:
```ts
function nearAzimuth(cc: CameraControlsImpl, target: number) {   // go the short way round after auto-rotate
  cc.normalizeRotations()
  const d = cc.azimuthAngle - target
  if (d > Math.PI) cc.rotate(-2 * Math.PI, 0, false); else if (d < -Math.PI) cc.rotate(2 * Math.PI, 0, false)
}
function flyToNodule(cc: CameraControlsImpl, sh: Shared, p: THREE.Vector3) {
  sh.focused = true; sh.auto = false
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3(p.x - sh.center.x, 0, p.z - sh.center.z)      // the nodule's own side
  if (dir.lengthSq() < 1) dir.set(0, 0, 1)
  dir.normalize().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.35)).setY(0.3).normalize()    // anterior bias, a bit above
  const pos = p.clone().addScaledVector(dir, THREE.MathUtils.clamp(sh.radius * 1.1, 120, 320))
  cc.smoothTime = 0.28                                                        // ≈ 1.2 s
  nearAzimuth(cc, Math.atan2(dir.x, dir.z))
  void cc.setLookAt(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, p.x, p.y, p.z, true)
}
// p = glb node bbox centre ?? rasToThree(center_mm); reset_view: setLookAt(home…, true).then(() => (sh.auto = true))
```

**Streamed ask** (abort the previous question, ignore stale turns):
```tsx
const submit = async (q: string) => {
  ctl.current?.abort(); const c = new AbortController(); ctl.current = c
  const id = ++seq.current
  const upd = (f: (t: Turn) => Turn) => setTurn((t) => (t && t.id === id ? f(t) : t))
  setTurn({ id, q, text: "", tools: [], status: "streaming" })
  try {
    for await (const ev of ask(studyUid, q, c.signal)) {
      if (ev.event === "delta") upd((t) => ({ ...t, text: t.text + ev.data.text }))
      else if (ev.event === "tool") upd((t) => ({ ...t, tools: [...t.tools, toolLabel(ev.data.tool, ev.data.args)] }))
      else if (ev.event === "error") upd((t) => ({ ...t, status: "error", error: ev.data.message }))
    }
    upd((t) => (t.status === "streaming" ? { ...t, status: "done" } : t))   // stream closed without `done` → done
  } catch (e) { upd((t) => (c.signal.aborted ? { ...t, status: "stopped" } : { ...t, status: "error", error: String(e) })) }
}
```

## Sybil research card (Oct 25 demo)

`src/components/risk-card.tsx` displays precomputed scores from `fixtures/sybil_risk.json` below the study Assessment management block. Lookup prefers exact study UID, then patient ID (removing a leading `fixture-`) plus timepoint. Unknown patients or timepoints render nothing. The fixture is ordered T0..T2 and the card includes only screens through the matched study.

This is a separate, muted research display, not a Lung-RADS category or input. No worker payload, rules, agent tool, or MCP change. The card always displays: “Research model · not a diagnosis · not part of Lung-RADS · precomputed offline on this box”. It also discloses possible NLST training overlap; these scores are not validation.

Verification on the box:

- `npm run build` passed (`tsc -b` and Vite). The direct relative JSON import works in dev; no `src/data` copy is needed. The production bundle renders the card in real Electron with no separate fixture request, so the served `ui/dist` carries the scores.
- Production Electron against an isolated mock: hero T0/T1/T2 displayed 1-year risks 2.8% / 26.9% / 40.2%, 6-year risks 13.6% / 56.3% / 68.6%, and trend lengths 1 / 2 / 3. Runtime component checks also covered exact-UID precedence, prefixed patient fallback, all three controls, and unknown patients/timepoints.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/worker -p test_risk_fixture.py -v`: three tests passed, covering all 12 patients × three screens, UID presence, and six bounded, nondecreasing yearly probabilities per screen. No scoring/checkpoint path was run.
- Read-only comparison with the active registry at `/home/dell/spark-md-runtime-w/registry.sqlite`: hero T0 UID matches; T1/T2 have no registry rows yet, so their UID comparison is unverified, not a known mismatch.
- Archived screenshots: [`sybil-t0.png`](../benchmarks/2026-10-25-ui-shots/sybil-t0.png) and [`sybil-t2.png`](../benchmarks/2026-10-25-ui-shots/sybil-t2.png). These show the built UI with mock CT assets, not real patient-image validation.
